char_golden_rule: If it can change between images, it does NOT belong in a character LoRA.
style_golden_rule: If it describes what is in the image instead of how it is rendered, it belongs in negatives.
pose_why: Pose LoRAs should generalize across characters and outfits.
outfit_why: Outfit LoRAs collapse quickly if identity leaks in.
